core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Consumer Health Products; FMCG; Vaccines and Medical Supplies; Logistics and Distribution
specialty_focus: Imperial Health Sciences is a specialized healthcare supply chain and logistics provider, offering warehousing, cold chain storage, distribution, and route-to-market solutions for pharmaceuticals and medical products across Sub-Saharan Africa. It serves public and private health sectors, institutional providers, and retail pharmacy networks, and is ISO and GDP compliant.
